## 🌳 CleanTree v1.1.0

CleanTree 1.1 adds a much faster way to answer the two questions that come up constantly while spending Soul Ash:

**What can I buy right now?**

…and:

**What should I buy next?**

This release adds **Buyable Now**, shareable **Shopping Lists**, and optional automatic purchase staging while keeping Project Ebonhold's native **Apply Changes** step under the player's control.

### 🛒 Shopping Lists

Shopping Lists are exact node-priority lists for planning a Soul Ash build.

- Create, copy, rename, and delete your own lists.
- Reorder nodes with **Top / Up / Down / Bottom** controls.
- Add specific nodes by search.
- Use **Append Missing** to keep your custom priorities at the top while filling in the rest of the finite tree afterward.
- Choose from built-in starter lists:
  - Full Tree Order
  - Damage First
  - Survival First
  - Convenience First
  - Balanced
  - Cheapest First

Shopping Lists use actual node IDs internally, so duplicate node names do not make a shared list ambiguous.

### 📤 Share builds with CTSL1

A Shopping List can be exported as one compact `CTSL1:` string.

Send that string to another player, have them click **Import**, paste it, and the entire ordered Shopping List is recreated immediately.

The format is versioned so CleanTree can evolve the sharing format later without silently breaking existing strings.

### ⚡ Auto Purchase

Click **AUTO-PURCHASE THIS LIST** to let CleanTree stage purchases in Shopping List priority order.

Auto Purchase:

- stages purchases through the real native Ebonhold Skill Tree;
- temporarily skips entries that are locked or unaffordable;
- starts again from priority #1 after every successful purchase;
- stops when nothing else on the list can currently be purchased;
- **never clicks Apply Changes for you**.

When Auto Purchase finishes, review **Cart** and click **Apply Changes** yourself.

### 💰 Buyable Now

The new **Buyable Now** button instantly filters the tree to nodes that are:

- not already maxed,
- structurally unlocked,
- bound to the live native tree,
- priced with a known next-rank cost,
- and affordable with your current Soul Ash.

The view updates after purchases, so spent nodes disappear and newly unlocked affordable nodes can appear immediately.

### 🖥️ UI improvements

- Shopping Lists now use the same black/charcoal visual style as the rest of CleanTree.
- Import/Export has a clearly marked text-entry area and automatic input focus.
- Shopping Lists correctly close with the Progression window.
- Shopping List controls now sit on the correct mouse/input layer.
- Auto Purchase status text no longer collides with the existing CleanTree header.

### 🌳 Existing CleanTree behavior retained

- All / Unowned / Damage / Survival / Convenience / Endless / Cart / Purchased views
- live EbonAPI prerequisite and server-loadout integration
- stable prerequisite-aware ordering
- staged-vs-committed purchase tracking
- repeatable Endless node support
- native Apply Changes
- native/CleanTree UI switching
- diagnostic commands for troubleshooting

### Requirements

- World of Warcraft 3.3.5a on Project Ebonhold
- [EbonAPI 1.0+](https://github.com/Siphelis/EbonAPI/releases/latest) installed separately

### Installation

1. Download `CleanTree-v1.1.0.zip` below.
2. Extract the `CleanTree` folder into `Interface/AddOns/`.
3. Make sure **EbonAPI** and **CleanTree** are enabled.
4. Open **Progression → Skill Tree** normally.

CleanTree does not automatically commit your Skill Tree. Purchases remain staged until **you** click **Apply Changes**.
